updates.title: Combat and stalling
added: The sidebar shows the round clock now, and from 10 minutes out it counts down to Sudden Death and then to the draw
Return to Lobby button on the spectate board
changed: Hits land like they are supposed to. Trading blows in a fight was dropping some hits so people took less damage than they should have
Eating a golden apple or drawing a bow slows you way down while you do it, like the original game. No more strafing at full speed while munching gapples
Sudden Death at 35 minutes shuts every base forge off, only diamonds and emeralds keep spawning. The round ends in a draw at 40 minutes instead of 50, so you can not turtle forever
fixed: TNT placed by anyone other than the instance host was getting stuck as a block that never went off and could not be broken. It lights and falls like it is supposed to now
removed: The staff menu is gone from Bed Wars

updates.title: Hotfix
fixed: Lit TNT actually falls now. It hops off the block, drops if there is nothing under it and blows up wherever it lands, like it is supposed to. Before it just sat in place

updates.title: Release
added: Spectating. Knocked out or joined mid round? There is a board on the deck now, pick anyone still playing and watch the round through their eyes, sound included
Stats and levels. XP, level, tokens, wins, kills, final kills, beds broken and your win streak save to your account and show on the lobby scoreboard. Every round ends with an XP summary in chat

Tag shop in the lobby. Name tags for VRChat credits: Supporter, Bed Breaker, Sweaty, Diamond Hoarder, Void Enjoyer, Sky Baser, Rusher and Rainbow, plus a custom tag where you type your own text and pick the colour
Effect icons on the HUD with timers, so you can see how long your speed, jump boost, gold hearts, slowness, mining fatigue or blindness has left
Sneak bridging. Crouch at the edge of a block and you stop instead of walking off, so you can bridge over the void like you are supposed to. VR players flick the right stick down to toggle sneak
Team coloured leather armour, and an enchant glint on sharpness swords, protection armour, the knockback stick and the Power and Punch bows
Eating and drinking has the animation, chewing sounds and crumbs now, and other players can see you doing it
A ding when your arrow hits someone
Beta testers board in the lobby with everyone who played the test rounds
changed: Teams are shuffled every round instead of the same people always landing on the same colour
Buying a better sword, bow, pickaxe or axe swaps out the old one instead of filling your hotbar
Swords, tools, bows and armour do not wear out in Bed Wars
The off hand slot is disabled in Bed Wars

Upgrade and trap names are closer to Hypixel: Sharpness Swords, Protection Armor, Haste Miner, Iron, Golden, Emerald and Molten Forge, Heal Pool, Blindness Trap, Counter-Offensive Trap and Mining Fatigue Trap
The map resets between rounds in a few seconds instead of regenerating the whole thing
Spectators stay on the deck and can not open chests or pick up drops
Flying or teleporting around the map with a modified client gets you removed from the match
The knockback stick has a little less kick
Gold hearts from golden apples soak up fall, fire and drowning damage too, not just hits
The loading screen has a bit more Bed Wars flavour
fixed: The blindness trap actually blinds you now, before you could still see other players clear as day through the dark
Forges could stop producing iron and gold for a base in the middle of a round
Fireballs flew straight through players unless you hit them dead centre
Sponges never soaked up flowing water, and water could flood the generators, shops and spawns. Both fixed
Water placed during a round was still there after the reset
Your bed breaking while you were waiting to respawn ate that respawn. You still get it now, like on Hypixel
The shop said you bought an iron pickaxe when you had bought a wooden one
The scoreboard cut off long lines like the map name
The custom tag text box grabbed your movement keys after you clicked a colour
Gold hearts stayed on the HUD after the round ended

updates.title: Closed Beta
added: Bed Wars is here as its own world. Protect your bed, break everyone else's, last team standing wins
Doubles and Solo modes on the lobby board, the instance master picks between rounds. 8 teams either way
Parties. Make one on the board, invite people, accept or decline invites, kick and leave. Parties stay together in Doubles and a full party of four gets split into two teams
Iron and gold forge at your base, diamonds on the side islands, emeralds in the middle. Generators tier up at 6, 12, 18 and 24 minutes and every bed breaks at 30
Item shop and team upgrades villagers at every base with the Hypixel prices, traps included
Fireballs, ender pearls, bridge eggs, TNT, pop-up towers, potions, golden apples, knockback sticks and the Power and Punch bows
Team tags over everyone's head in their team colour so you can tell who to swing at
Fresh lobby: welcome and how to play boards, terms of use and a party board that looks like it belongs in the game
